The '''Taris Resistance Stronghold''' was the main base of the [[Taris Resistance]] during the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Taris Siege|siege]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[3963 BBY]].<ref name="KotOR22" /> The base was lost to the Mandalorians just prior to the [[mission to the Jedi Tower]].<ref name="KotOR24">[[Knights of the Old Republic 24|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 24]]</ref>
